mathlib_searches.query: A finite module over a local Noetherian ring has positive depth if its maximal ideal is not an associated prime

title: positive depth from no maximal associated prime
statement: Let R be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local commutative ring and M a finite R-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. If the maximal ideal of R is not an associated prime of M, then the depth of M [def-weil-pbc-depth] is at least one, including the zero module, whose depth is infinity.

lean.statement:
theorem depth_one_of_finite_localized_module_of_no_maximal_associated
    {R M : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M]
    (h : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R ∉ associatedPrimes R M) :
    (1 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) M
